title: Sales Data Cleanup
name: Sales Data Cleanup
shortDescription: Clean a messy sales dataset by resolving missing values, duplicate records, and inconsistent currency formatting.
description: In this challenge, you will take raw business sales records with missing customer IDs, erratic date formats, and duplicate transaction rows. You will apply systematic data cleansing workflows to eliminate errors and produce an analysis-ready dataset.
expectedOutcome: A clean, standardized, and audit-ready sales dataset with zero duplicate entries and normalized formatting.
objective: Prepare messy real-world business data for accurate downstream analytical modeling.
deliverable: Cleaned CSV/Sheet containing verified transactions and a changelog summarizing fixes applied.
expectedResult: A consistent dataset with all 100% data sanity checks validated.

title: Customer Insights & Cohort Analysis
name: Customer Insights Analysis
shortDescription: Use formulas, Pivot Tables, and segmentation to explore customer purchase behavior and reveal revenue drivers.
description: Analyze multi-month customer purchase histories to answer critical business questions: Which segments generate the highest customer lifetime value? What are the peak ordering days? How frequently do repeat purchases occur?
expectedOutcome: A structured analytical summary with pivot summaries and executive KPI callouts.
objective: Transform transactional records into actionable customer segmentation insights.
deliverable: Pivot-driven analysis sheet answering 5 key managerial questions with visual summaries.
expectedResult: Clear evidence-based observations on customer spending habits.

title: Business Performance KPI Dashboard
name: Business Performance Dashboard
shortDescription: Design an executive dashboard that communicates vital operational and revenue metrics with dynamic charting.
description: Synthesize monthly revenue, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost (CAC), and regional fulfillment speed into an interactive visual dashboard. Choose effective chart types that reduce cognitive load for stakeholders.
expectedOutcome: A polished single-page executive dashboard with dynamic filtering and trend charts.
objective: Bridge complex underlying figures into intuitive executive visual summaries.
deliverable: An interactive KPI dashboard with slicers for regional and monthly breakdowns.
expectedResult: A dashboard that stakeholders can inspect to immediately diagnose monthly performance.

title: Customer Churn Prediction Investigation
name: Customer Churn Investigation
shortDescription: Examine subscriber behavioral patterns and cancellation timestamps to diagnose core churn causes and recommend interventions.
description: Explore historical telecom/subscription usage records to discover lead indicators of customer cancellation. Correlate support ticket volume, contract duration, payment method, and monthly usage dips to model churn probability.
expectedOutcome: An analytical report identifying the top 3 drivers of customer churn with prioritized retention strategies.
objective: Apply exploratory data analysis to solve a high-impact business retention challenge.
deliverable: Executive presentation deck / report with data-backed retention intervention roadmap.
expectedResult: Actionable churn profiles with measurable retention intervention recommendations.

title: Responsive Brand Landing Page
name: Responsive Landing Page
shortDescription: Build a responsive, accessible company landing page using semantic HTML5, CSS Flexbox, and CSS Grid.
description: Transform a brand design brief into clean, mobile-first web markup. Implement semantic document structure, accessible ARIA landmarks, flexible typography, responsive imagery, and pure CSS navigation that adapts smoothly across screen sizes.
expectedOutcome: A fully responsive multi-section landing page passing modern web responsiveness criteria.
objective: Master modern responsive layout techniques without relying on bulky CSS frameworks.
deliverable: Pristine HTML/CSS codebase with responsive navigation, hero section, and curriculum grid.
expectedResult: Flawless rendering from 320px mobile screens to 1440px desktop displays.

title: Interactive Task Tracker Component
name: Interactive Task Tracker
shortDescription: Develop an interactive task checklist with client-side state, status filtering, and live progress computation.
description: Implement vanilla JavaScript event handling, dynamic DOM creation, and live array manipulation to allow users to toggle task completion, filter items by status, and see a progress bar animate in real time.
expectedOutcome: An interactive browser application with zero page refreshes during state transitions.
objective: Master DOM manipulation, event delegation, and reactive client state management.
deliverable: Interactive tracker widget featuring dynamic task cards and animated progress bar.
expectedResult: Smooth interactive filtering and instant UI synchronization on every click.

title: Dynamic Multi-Filter Challenge Explorer
name: Challenge Explorer Engine
shortDescription: Create a multi-criteria filter pipeline supporting simultaneous track, difficulty, and live keyword search.
description: Build an algorithmic search and filter engine where multiple filter pill groups (track, difficulty) and a debounced text search input work together in a single pipeline to filter a collection of items with instantaneous feedback and empty state handling.
expectedOutcome: A responsive search and filter experience that handles combined query conditions gracefully.
objective: Architect scalable client-side filtering pipelines and accessible keyboard-navigable UI controls.
deliverable: Filterable catalog with active counters, reset button, and accessible detail modal.
expectedResult: Sub-millisecond filtering across multiple criteria with zero layout shift.

title: Full-Stack REST API & Persistence Engine
name: Full-Stack REST API Integration
shortDescription: Build a robust Node.js and Express REST API supporting CRUD endpoints, strict validation, and JSON file persistence.
description: Create a backend server with Express that provides GET, PUT, POST, DELETE endpoints for task records. Implement HTTP status codes (200, 201, 400, 404, 500), input sanitization, error handling middleware, and atomic asynchronous file operations to disk.
expectedOutcome: A production-grade REST API server verified with automated integration tests.
objective: Build genuine client-server architectures connecting frontend fetch() to backend persistence.
deliverable: Working Express API server with endpoints connected to persistent tasks.json and automated tests.
expectedResult: 100% passing automated test suite verifying status validation and disk persistence.
